$provisional: PROVISIONAL placeholders: day length, hours, routines, restock levels, stall odds and all lines are tuning values, not Canon. See docs/PROVISIONAL.md.

activities.opening-up: Fire's only just caught — give it a minute and the place'll be warm.
activities.busy-evening: Evening rush! Shout if you want anything, I'll hear you over the singing. Probably.
activities.asleep: Mm? We're shut, love. Come back when the sun's up.

actor_maren-holloway.friendly: There's my favourite regular. The usual seat's free.
barks: Best loaf this side of the mere.
Enjoy it — and tell your friends.

activities.setting-up: Not open yet — the awning's half up. Five minutes!
activities.evening-drink: Shop's shut. I'm off duty, which means I'm only *mostly* selling things.

actor_tobias-quill.friendly: Ah, my best supplier! What can Quill's do for you today?
barks: Come again — I restock every morning.

activities.morning-chores: Hens first, then sheep, then me. That's the order of the world.
activities.lunch: Sit a moment if you like. Bread's yesterday's but the cheese isn't.
activities.orchard-work: Mind the ladder. And the wasps. Mostly the wasps.
activities.asleep: *a lantern goes out behind the farmhouse window*

actor_hester-brindle.friendly: There you are. The hound's missed you — well, I have too, a bit.

activities.deliveries: Can't stop — Quill's crates won't carry themselves. Walk with me?
activities.telling-stories: …and THAT'S why you never take the low road past Hollowmere after dark. Sit, sit!
activities.asleep: *snoring, with a letter still in hand*

actor_pip-ashdown.friendly: You! My favourite satchel-finder. What news?

activities.reading-notices: Somebody keeps pinning recipes to the official notice board. Somebody will be found.
activities.supper: I am off duty. Mostly. What is it?
activities.asleep: The gatehouse door stays shut. A note says: 'Office opens at eight.'

actor_aldous-crane.friendly: Ah. A responsible citizen. Blackmere could use more of those.

activities.sightseeing: Every town has one good well and a hundred stories about it. This one's well is very good.
activities.asleep: *Sela is curled up by the fire, a map over her face*

actor_sela-vantry.friendly: Friend! Sit, tell me where the road's taken you since.

acquired: {name} bounds over, sniffs your boots thoroughly, and decides you'll do.
fed: {name} wolfs it down, tail going like a flail.
{name} crunches happily and then checks the floor for crumbs.
{name} eats, then leans against your leg, satisfied.
rested: {name} circles three times and flops down with a huge sigh.
{name} naps with one ear still listening.
home: {name} claims the spot by the hearth as if it was always theirs.
bonded: {name} brings you a stick, then refuses to let go of it. Great fun.
{name} rolls over for a belly rub. You oblige.
You and {name} race to the nearest tree. {name} wins.
hungry: {name} is nosing at your pocket, hopefully.
idle: {name} watches the birds with deep suspicion.

acquired: Bramble skids to a stop at your feet, white blaze first, muddy everything else. She's decided.
idle: Bramble is very interested in a leaf. Now a different leaf.
Bramble glances back to make sure you're still there.
Bramble has found mud. Bramble is happy.

acquired: The moth settles on your shoulder, glowing faintly amber.
fed: The moth sips at the seed cake, its light brightening.
Its wings pulse gold as it feeds.
rested: The moth folds its wings; its glow dims to an ember.
home: The moth settles on the lantern hook, glowing softly.
bonded: The moth traces slow loops around your hands.
It lands on your fingertip and stays there.
hungry: The moth's glow flickers, faint and uneven.
tired: The moth drifts low, light dim.
idle: The moth circles your head in lazy loops.
Its light catches every falling leaf.
The raven watches you with one bright, judging eye.
The raven says something that sounds a lot like 'eleven years'.
